headline: Datamatics Global Services Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition — Datamatics Global Services Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of remaining 20% stakes in TNQ Tech Private Limited by its Wholly owned subsidiary Lumina Datamatics Limited.
